description: Airworthy Mosquito restored in British Columbia and flown again on 16 June 2014 as Bob Jens' CF-HMJ; it flies in the markings of LR503 'F-for-Freddie', RAF 103 Squadron. Built by Airspeed in 1948 and operated by Spartan Air Services 1954-1963. Moved to the KF collection in Kelowna.
aliases: Mosquito; DH98; CF-HMJ; C-FHMJ; LR503; Mosquito B Mk 35
